svg.title: A − B = R by components
svg.desc: A at angle θA above the +x axis, followed by −B, gives R below the x axis at angle θ. Along x, Rx = Ax + (−Bx); along y, Ry = Ay + (−By). An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: A = 53.0 m at 20.0°, B = 34.0 m at 63.0°. Rotating B by 180° gives −B; head-to-tail addition then
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
